note: Starting set loaded into the app on seed. Rules are edited in the app afterwards; each change is a draft until a clinical reviewer approves it. Plausible demo content, not clinically reviewed: a named clinician must check every rule and reference before any real use. Messages never advise starting, stopping or changing a medicine.

rules.title: Medication requires review: anticoagulant recorded
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include an anticoagulant. Review its relevance to the planned procedure (bleeding risk).
rules.rationale: Anticoagulants are relevant to bleeding management for invasive and surgical procedures.
rules.reference: SDCEP, Management of Dental Patients Taking Anticoagulants or Antiplatelet Drugs, 2nd edition (2022); local peri-procedural guidance. Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: antiplatelet agent before surgery
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include an antiplatelet agent. Review its relevance to the planned surgery, including any coronary stent recorded.
rules.rationale: Antiplatelet agents affect surgical bleeding; after a coronary stent the cardiac risk of interruption also matters.
rules.reference: ESC/ESAnaesthesiology guideline on non-cardiac surgery (2022). Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: NSAID before surgery
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include an NSAID. Review its relevance to the planned surgery (bleeding and kidney function).
rules.rationale: NSAIDs affect platelet function and renal perfusion around surgery.
rules.reference: Local peri-operative medicines guidance. Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: NSAID before gastrointestinal endoscopy
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include an NSAID. Review its relevance to the planned endoscopy, particularly with liver disease, varices or gastrointestinal bleeding.
rules.rationale: NSAIDs increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk and are relevant in portal hypertension.
rules.reference: Local gastroenterology guidance. Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: metformin with contrast media
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include metformin and the procedure uses iodinated contrast. Review its relevance, including the most recent kidney function (eGFR).
rules.rationale: Metformin with iodinated contrast is relevant to the risk of lactic acidosis when kidney function is reduced.
rules.reference: RCR/ACR contrast media guidance. Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: metformin around fasting for the procedure
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include metformin and the procedure involves fasting. Review the plan for diabetes medicines around the procedure.
rules.rationale: Diabetes medicines need a peri-procedural plan when the patient fasts.
rules.reference: JBDS-IP, Management of adults with diabetes undergoing surgery (2023). Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: insulin around fasting for the procedure
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include insulin and the procedure involves fasting. Review the plan for glucose control before and after the procedure.
rules.rationale: Insulin with fasting carries a risk of hypoglycaemia without a plan.
rules.reference: JBDS-IP, Management of adults with diabetes undergoing surgery (2023). Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: sulfonylurea around fasting for the procedure
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include a sulfonylurea and the procedure involves fasting. Review the plan for glucose control around the procedure.
rules.rationale: Sulfonylureas with fasting carry a risk of hypoglycaemia.

rules.title: Medication requires review: SGLT2 inhibitor before surgery
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include an SGLT2 inhibitor. Review its relevance to the planned procedure and fasting.
rules.rationale: SGLT2 inhibitors are associated with euglycaemic ketoacidosis around surgery and fasting.
rules.reference: JBDS-IP (2023); MHRA safety advice. Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: bisphosphonate with oral surgery
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include a bisphosphonate. Review its relevance to the planned oral surgery (medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw).
rules.rationale: Bisphosphonates are associated with osteonecrosis of the jaw after dental extraction.
rules.reference: SDCEP, Oral Health Management of Patients at Risk of Medication-related Osteonecrosis of the Jaw (2017). Reviewer to confirm.

rules.title: Medication requires review: systemic corticosteroid before surgery
rules.message: The patient's current medicines include a systemic corticosteroid. Review its relevance to the planned surgery and anaesthesia.
rules.rationale: Long-term corticosteroids are relevant to adrenal suppression during surgery.
rules.reference: AAGBI guideline on peri-operative steroids (2020). Reviewer to confirm.
